import sqlite3,json,platform
c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
c.set_authorizer(lambda *args: sqlite3.SQLITE_OK)
c.execute('SELECT 1').fetchone()
c.set_authorizer(None)
r={'python':platform.python_version(),'sqlite':sqlite3.sqlite_version}
try: r['after_none']=c.execute('SELECT 2').fetchone()
except Exception as e:r['after_none']={'type':type(e).__name__,'message':str(e),'sqlite_errorcode':getattr(e,'sqlite_errorcode',None)}
c.set_authorizer(lambda *args: sqlite3.SQLITE_OK)
r['after_explicit_allow']=c.execute('SELECT 3').fetchone()
c.close();print(json.dumps(r))
